title: Restart gap breaches the 60 s exit-eval requirement (62.2 s 09:31Z, 64.1 s 10:58Z): start the exit loop before heavy boot init, and stop restarting the trader for trainer-only files
note: [TICK-STAGE2 lane, MEASURED 2026-11-05 via relay #23266/#23271: trader journalctl, ict-git-sync journalctl, exit_interval_soak, exit_loop_health] 10:58Z restart, gap 64.1 s = (a) 26.2 s: old process's last exit pass ~10:57:28.8 (derived: first-pass 10:58:32.88 minus 64.1 s) to systemctl restart 10:57:55 -- the old loop was mid-sleep; (b) <1 s stop (Stopping/Stopped/Started all 10:57:55); (c) 1.9 s to the WAL line 10:57:56.9; (d) 13.4 s restart-report broker reads to boot_audit line 10:58:10.3 (main() joins start_restart_report_thread up to REPORT_WAIT_S=45 s BEFORE _start_exit_loop); (e) 9.0 s strategy_versions snapshot + _apply_per_account_leverage + adapter/telegram build to 'exit-evaluation loop DECOUPLED' 10:58:19.4; (f) 13.5 s cold first pass (max_pass_ms 13478.7; steady passes ~1 s). Boot-to-exit-thread = 23.5 s, of which 22.4 s is init the exit loop does not need. ROOT CAUSE OF THIS RESTART: ict-git-sync 'Trader restart gate: restart (fec3de0..d123bec: non_py_runtime: deploy/trainer/Caddyfile.console)' -- scripts/ops/trader_import_closure.NON_RUNTIME_PATHS_RE (lockstep with scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh and diag _NON_RUNTIME_PATHS_RE, pinned by tests/test_diag_restart_pending_lockstep.py) does not list deploy/trainer/, so a trainer-VM-only file restarted the live trader. 10:21Z restart for comparison: report 10:21:14, exit thread 10:21:23, first pass 13.3 s, gap 49.0 s. FIX (held PR, Tier 2): (1) start the exit loop right after WAL init, before the restart-report join, leverage and adapter build (saves ~22 s; check the report thread and the first exit pass do not contend on the IB pinned socket); (2) add deploy/trainer/ to the non-runtime set in all three lockstep places; (3) optional: bound (a) by a final exit pass on SIGTERM or by ict-git-sync waiting for the exit loop's pass boundary. Expected gap after (1): 26 + ~2 + ~13.5 = ~42 s < 45 s target, INFERRED. PROOF: a unit test that main() starts the exit-evaluation thread before start_restart_report_thread, plus the next deploy's 'exit restart gap: within - <45000ms' journal line and no EXIT-EVAL RESTART GAP BREACHED in /api/bot/alerts.
